source_claims.quote: A mermaid is a mythical sea-dwelling creature, often described as having the head and body of a woman and a fish's tail below the waist.

statement.id: Putri duyung adalah makhluk laut mitis berkepala dan bertubuh atas perempuan serta berekor ikan.
statement.en: A mermaid is a mythical sea being with a woman's upper body and a fish tail.

source_claims.quote: The Havfrue, or Mermaid, is represented in the popular tradition sometimes as a good, at other times as an evil and treacherous being. She is beautiful in her appearance.

statement.id: Havfrue, atau putri duyung, dalam tradisi rakyat digambarkan kadang sebagai makhluk baik dan kadang sebagai makhluk jahat dan licik; ia cantik rupanya.
statement.en: The Havfrue, or Mermaid, is represented in popular tradition sometimes as good, at other times as an evil and treacherous being; she is beautiful in her appearance.

source_claims.quote: Fishermen sometimes see her in the bright summer's sun, when a thin mist hangs over the sea, sitting on the surface of the water, and combing her long golden hair with a golden comb, or driving up her snow-white cattle

statement.id: Nelayan kadang melihatnya di bawah matahari musim panas, duduk di permukaan air menyisir rambut emas panjangnya dengan sisir emas, atau menggiring ternak putih saljunya.
statement.en: Fishermen sometimes see her in the bright summer sun, sitting on the surface of the water combing her long golden hair with a golden comb, or driving up her snow-white cattle.

source_claims.quote: Her appearance prognosticates both storm and ill success in their fishing. People that are drowned, and whose bodies are not found, are believed to be taken into the dwellings of the Mermaids.

statement.id: Kemunculannya menandakan badai dan kegagalan menangkap ikan; orang yang tenggelam dan jasadnya tidak ditemukan dipercaya dibawa ke tempat tinggal para putri duyung.
statement.en: Her appearance prognosticates both storm and ill success in fishing; drowned people whose bodies are not found are believed to be taken into the dwellings of the Mermaids.

artistic_choices: Palette, camera, age details, opaque clothing embellishment and unspecific staging are editorial choices, not additional source facts.
Dominance through close framing and foreshortening unless source documents scale.
No outward power added beyond documented domain; weather, light and debris remain physically grounded.
